laws.fullDescription: Oklahoma prohibits stalking — repeated non-consensual contact causing substantial distress. Stalking prohibited; cyberstalking covered.
laws.penalty: First-degree stalking: felony. Second-degree: misdemeanor.
laws.exceptions: Lawful investigations by law enforcement are not considered stalking.

laws.fullDescription: Oklahoma: Dangerous exotic animals generally prohibited as pets.
